scripts.build: nub run --filter @gpuixui/testing build && nub run vendor && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.dev: nub run build && nub watch dist/main.js
scripts.smoke: nub run build && cd ../.. && nub apps/playground/dist/smoke/run.js
scripts.smoke:live: nub run build && cd ../.. && nub apps/playground/dist/live/run.js --all
scripts.check-types: nub run --filter @gpuixui/testing build && nub run vendor && tsc -p tsconfig.check.json
scripts.test: nub run --filter @gpuixui/testing build && nub run vendor && vitest run
